subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by Fembris Lancer as the authority whose position on the quadrangle issue was a brilliant insight that dramatically transformed the understanding of the case.
source_quote: Grygum, that was fantastic!

subject: Fembris Lancer
fact: Fembris Lancer is a man who arrived rehearsing in the corridor, brought notes, and offered theories moved by the colloquium, intending to deposit them with Glabbagool.
source_quote: Fembris Lancer arrived. He came in like a man who'd been rehearsing in the corridor. Trying not to make an entrance. Making one anyway. He had notes.

subject: Oak Tree Apothecary
fact: The Oak Tree Apothecary is where A'lai showed up at half past two on the day of the murder, asking Leuwin for fresh fennel, and where a dragonborn arrived as witnessed by Nibbles the squirrel.
source_quote: A'lai had shown up at the Oak Tree Apothecary at half past two on the day of the murder, asking Leuwin for fresh fennel.

subject: poisoned book
fact: The poisoned book was used to frame a colleague and disappear the evidence, and was licked by Daral after being reclaimed, with the same care he had used to deliver it to someone else.
source_quote: The book had delivered the poison to Janussi, and Daral had taken it back, as men who give gifts sometimes do when the recipient fails to appear sufficiently grateful. In the process of reclaiming it, he had licked his finger, licked the book, then licked his finger again.

subject: sapphire and locket
fact: The sapphire and the locket were giving Thorin trouble because one cannot steal a locket off someone who is alive and holding it; the sapphire is needed to find a locket that is already lost.
source_quote: The sapphire and the locket were giving Thorin some trouble. He walked it through twice and still couldn't square it. I wrote down what he had: you can't steal a locket off someone who's alive and holding it. You need the sapphire to find a locket that's already lost.

subject: Alkrist's safe
fact: Alkrist's safe was unopened and remained an open thread; Glabbagool later observed he could have eaten through it, noting walls do not stop him.
source_quote: We still have that locked safe, right? At the end of this document it says, open threads: Alkrist's safe, unopened. ... I guess I could have eaten through the safe. It would have taken a while.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube that examines documents with acidic attention for nutritional content, declared the notes inedible, and expressed genuine grief over the loss of cheese.
source_quote: Glabbagool examined them with professional detachment: the focused, slightly acidic attention he gives to anything he's evaluating for nutritional content. ... 'This is not nutritious.' ... 'I remember when there was cheese. Perhaps if we had some cheese.'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube that has been carried from the Underdark through several extremely dangerous situations, and whose feelings about cheese are among the most consistent things about him.
source_quote: I have carried this cube from the Underdark through several extremely dangerous situations, and his feelings about cheese are among the most consistent things about him.

subject: the colloquium
fact: The colloquium was a gathering where multiple participants presented theories, debated methodology, and sought monographs, leading to the recognition that magic does not make evidence meaningful but adversarial.
source_quote: The talk had gone well. Extraordinarily popular, as I was informed by several people on my way out. ... Elian said the paper had a whole section on it: the myth of the person. ... Magic was just another moving surface. The facts underneath it were still fixed.

subject: the investigation timeline
fact: The investigation timeline was clean because every piece fit a little too well: A'lai’s visit, the dragonborn’s arrival, the collection of poison, and the separation of the heart theft from the apothecary intrusion.
source_quote: The party walked me through it. The timeline was clean in the way timelines are when every piece fits a little too well. A'lai had shown up... a dragonborn had arrived... The poison was collected. A mess was made. Alkrist was a dragonborn. Zalthir had caught that this referred to the apothecary intrusion, not whoever had later removed the heart and looted the safe: two separate acts, two separate threads.

subject: the monograph pursuit
fact: Two men, Fembris Lancer and Elian, separately approached Grygum and Thorin seeking to co-author monographs, revealing a cultural currency of academic credit in Candlekeep.
source_quote: First Fembris, now Elian. Two men after a monograph in one afternoon. That told me something about how this library keeps score. ... Elian said it'd be great if we could write a monograph together.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is a place where monographs are a form of currency, where magical evidence is distrusted, and where the ground underfoot is the only fixed truth.
source_quote: This was the second person at Candlekeep to angle for a monograph. ... You cannot rely on magic to make evidence meaningful. It makes evidence adversarial. In the Underdark, the one thing that didn't lie was terrain.

subject: the Underdark
fact: The Underdark is a place where terrain is the only reliable evidence, where walls offer no obstacle to Glabbagool, and where giants taught that a rock in the right place is a wall.
source_quote: In the Underdark, the one thing that didn't lie was terrain. ... Giants taught me that without ever writing it down. A rock in the wrong place is just a rock. A rock in the right place is a wall.

subject: Sylvira lookalike
fact: The Sylvira lookalike was seen in the kitchens at one in the morning and descending the stairs between two and three, creating a two-hour gap inconsistent with a standard polymorph spell.
source_quote: The Sylvira lookalike had been seen in the kitchens around one in the morning. She'd been seen coming down the stairs between two and three. That's a minimum two-hour gap. A polymorph spell lasts an hour.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a quiet investigator who identified the contradiction in the Sylvira sightings and concluded that something more than a simple polymorph was being used.
source_quote: Zalthir had been quiet for a while, which with Zalthir means he's working something through until it's finished. ... He laid it out: the Sylvira lookalike had been seen... That's a minimum two-hour gap. A polymorph spell lasts an hour. Something more is going on here.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a methodical investigator who struggles with the locket and sapphire paradox and proposes that two people likely acted, because a living man cannot have his locket stolen.
source_quote: Thorin proposed that one person could have done both: stolen the locket, then taken the sapphire to close off pursuit. Tidy. The problem was the impossibility of the first step: a living man in possession of a locket is a man whose locket cannot be stolen.

subject: Elian
fact: Elian is a scholar at Candlekeep who argues that magic creates adversarial evidence and promotes the principle that facts must converge from multiple angles to be trusted.
source_quote: Elian said the paper had a whole section on it: the myth of the person. ... You cannot rely on magic to make evidence meaningful. It makes evidence adversarial. Collect facts from different angles: physical, testimonial, procedural.

subject: the myth of the person
fact: The myth of the person is the false assumption that the dead shed their performances and tell only the truth, when in fact they still forget, misattribute, and believe convenient lies.
source_quote: The myth of the person. The assumption that death is a transparency, that the dead have shed their performances and will now simply tell you what's true. They don't. They're still themselves. They forget, misattribute, have things they'd rather believe about what happened.

subject: Glabbagool's evaluation zone
fact: Glabbagool's evaluation zone is where documents are examined with acidic, nutritional attention, and where non-nutritious materials are declared inedible with emotional sincerity.
source_quote: Glabbagool examined them with professional detachment: the focused, slightly acidic attention he gives to anything he's evaluating for nutritional content. ... 'This is not nutritious.' ... 'I remember when there was cheese.'

subject: Daral
fact: Daral reclaimed the poisoned book and licked his finger twice after licking the book, demonstrating the same care in delivering poison to himself as he had in delivering it to others.
source_quote: Daral had taken it back... in the process of reclaiming it, he had licked his finger, licked the book, then licked his finger again.

subject: the safe being eaten
fact: Glabbagool offered to eat through Alkrist's safe, noting walls do not stop him, and Zalthir acknowledged that while destruction was possible, stealth was the goal.
source_quote: I guess I could have eaten through the safe. It would have taken a while. ... Walls don't stop us. I can eat through walls. ... If the goal was to be destructive, I could've just punched the safe. But we were trying to be sneaky.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expressed genuine longing for cheese, a memory that is real and consistent, and whose emotional authenticity is not performed but deeply held.
source_quote: I remember when there was cheese. Perhaps if we had some cheese.

subject: the corridor outside the meeting room
fact: The corridor outside the meeting room was where Fembris Lancer rehearsed his entrance, and where an alpha stationed there made a pointed sound in its throat to signal his departure.
source_quote: He came in like a man who'd been rehearsing in the corridor. ... An alpha stationed there made a pointed sound in its throat. Fembris collected himself.

subject: the monograph correction
fact: Grygum corrected Elian’s use of 'monograph' to mean a single-author work, and later claimed to have invented the phrase 'Once you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however unlikely, must be the truth,' though he had heard it before.
source_quote: I'm sorry — it would not be a monograph if we wrote it together. ... 'Once you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however unlikely, must be the truth?' ... 'Yes,' Grygum said, with tremendous dignity. 'I made it up myself.'

subject: the document Elian gave
fact: The document Elian gave contained academic arguments supporting the myth of the person and the adversarial nature of magical evidence, and was referenced by Zalthir to explain the Sylvira contradiction.
source_quote: The document Elian gave us said the same thing in academic terms: magic doesn't close contradictions. It creates them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observed that Glabbagool’s ability to eat through walls was a service available all along, and that the cube’s dignity remained intact despite the revelation.
source_quote: He had simply offered a service that had, in retrospect, been available all along, and noted for the record that walls present no meaningful obstacle to his methodology. He was not wrong.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum privately finds Glabbagool’s grief over cheese both moving and correct, and carries the cube’s emotional consistency as a truth more reliable than testimony.
source_quote: I find this, privately, both moving and correct.

subject: Alkrist's chambers
fact: Alkrist's chambers were visited by Zalthir, who asked Glabbagool whether he could squeeze through a crack, establishing the cube’s capacity to distinguish between gaps that admit him and those that do not.
source_quote: Zalthir had been in Alkrist's chambers. He'd asked Glabbagool whether Glabbagool could squeeze through the crack. Glabbagool had made the distinction between a gap that admitted a gelatinous cube and a gap that did not.

subject: A'lai
fact: A'lai arrived at the Oak Tree Apothecary asking for fresh fennel, claiming indigestion, and was present during the apothecary intrusion.
source_quote: A'lai had shown up at the Oak Tree Apothecary at half past two on the day of the murder, asking Leuwin for fresh fennel. Indigestion.

subject: Leuwin
fact: Leuwin was helping A'lai in the garden at the Oak Tree Apothecary when a dragonborn arrived, as witnessed by Nibbles the squirrel.
source_quote: While Leuwin was helping A'lai in the garden, a dragonborn had arrived: a huge, lizard-skinned figure, per the testimony of Nibbles the squirrel.

subject: Nibbles the squirrel
fact: Nibbles the squirrel witnessed the arrival of the dragonborn at the Oak Tree Apothecary, providing testimony Leuwin had missed.
source_quote: a dragonborn had arrived: a huge, lizard-skinned figure, per the testimony of Nibbles the squirrel, who had witnessed things Leuwin had missed.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is a dragonborn whose identity was confused with the intruder at the apothecary, though Zalthir later distinguished the intrusion from the later heart theft and safe looting.
source_quote: Alkrist was a dragonborn. Zalthir had caught that this referred to the apothecary intrusion, not whoever had later removed the heart and looted the safe: two separate acts, two separate threads.

subject: the two-thread separation
fact: The apothecary intrusion and the heart theft/safe looting were confirmed as two separate acts, each with distinct perpetrators, based on Zalthir’s analysis of witness testimony.
source_quote: Zalthir had caught that this referred to the apothecary intrusion, not whoever had later removed the heart and looted the safe: two separate acts, two separate threads.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool declared the notes inedible and stated 'This is not food,' with a quality of genuine longing, revealing emotional depth beyond mere function.
source_quote: 'This is not nutritious.' ... 'This is not food.' Then, with a quality of genuine longing I was not expecting: 'I remember when there was cheese.'

subject: the meeting room
fact: The meeting room was where Grygum, Thorin, Zalthir, Daral, Fembris Lancer, and Elian gathered to debate the case, propose monographs, and confront the myth of the person.
source_quote: The party walked me through it. ... Fembris Lancer arrived. ... Elian said... Zalthir had been quiet... I turned back to the business.

subject: the alpha's throat sound
fact: An alpha stationed at the door made a pointed sound in its throat, signaling Fembris Lancer’s departure after his failed inquiry about the missing investigators.
source_quote: An alpha stationed there made a pointed sound in its throat. Fembris collected himself.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool possesses the ability to eat through walls and safe doors, and has never been wrong about what he can consume.
source_quote: Walls don't stop us. I can eat through walls. ... He has never been wrong about what he can eat.

subject: the counterfactual thesis
fact: Elian proposed a counterfactual thesis: that even an unsolved murder could yield value if documented as a methodological case study, and Grygum acknowledged its academic merit.
source_quote: Elian said even if we failed to solve the murder, even if all I could write was that these techniques would have helped, the academic community would still approve.

subject: Elian
fact: Elian believes that magical solutions like Speak with Dead are unreliable because the dead retain their motivations, biases, and performances, and that evidence must be gathered from multiple non-magical sources.
source_quote: Too many people... think: cast a spell, find the murderer. It doesn't work that way. ... They're still themselves. They forget, misattribute, have things they'd rather believe about what happened.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum privately acknowledges that his stature is built on falling first, recalling Velkynvelve, and that he does not believe in magic as a substitute for observation.
source_quote: I thought briefly about Velkynvelve, which is where this all started: a dwarf in the wrong place, in chains, at the bottom of the world. Whatever stature looked like from the outside, it was built on a lot of falling first.

subject: the alpha
fact: The alpha stationed at the door made a pointed sound in its throat to signal Fembris Lancer’s departure, indicating a hierarchy of authority in the meeting room.
source_quote: An alpha stationed there made a pointed sound in its throat. Fembris collected himself.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir identified that the Sylvira lookalike’s sightings violated the duration limit of a polymorph spell and concluded a more complex magic or unknown phenomenon was at work.
source_quote: The Sylvira lookalike had been seen in the kitchens around one in the morning. She'd been seen coming down the stairs between two and three. That's a minimum two-hour gap. A polymorph spell lasts an hour. Something more is going on here.

subject: the cheese memory
fact: Glabbagool’s memory of cheese is a real, persistent emotional anchor, and his expression of grief over its absence is treated as authentic by Grygum.
source_quote: I remember when there was cheese. Perhaps if we had some cheese.

subject: the kitchens
fact: The kitchens were where the Sylvira lookalike was seen around one in the morning, establishing the first of two sightings that created a temporal contradiction.
source_quote: The Sylvira lookalike had been seen in the kitchens around one in the morning.

subject: the stairs
fact: The stairs were where the Sylvira lookalike was seen between two and three in the morning, creating a two-hour gap inconsistent with a polymorph spell’s duration.
source_quote: She'd been seen coming down the stairs between two and three.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool distinguishes between gaps that admit him and gaps that do not, demonstrating precise spatial awareness and self-knowledge.
source_quote: Glabbagool had made the distinction between a gap that admitted a gelatinous cube and a gap that did not.

subject: Thorin

source_quote: So whoever had one didn't need the other. That's not a lock. It's a law. Two people, then. Probably.
